name: TensorTunes
description: AI-powered music label. Query real-time information about AI-generated music releases, TensorTunesToken (TTT), streaming statistics, community, and music production technology.

skills.name: Get Music Releases
skills.description: Returns latest TensorTunes AI-generated music releases on Spotify and other platforms
examples: How many tracks has TensorTunes released?

skills.name: Get TT Token Information
skills.description: Returns TensorTunesToken (TTT) price, supply, buyback statistics, and tokenomics model
examples: What is the TTT token price?
How does the TensorTunes token work?
What percentage of revenue is reinvested into TTT?

skills.name: Get Streaming Statistics
skills.description: Returns current streaming metrics, play counts, monthly listeners, and growth data
examples: How many streams does TensorTunes have?

skills.name: General TensorTunes Inquiry
skills.description: Answer any question about TensorTunes including mission, AI technology, community, Discord, partnerships, and contact information
examples: How does TensorTunes use AI to make music?
How can I join the TensorTunes community?
What AI models does TensorTunes use?
How can I collaborate with TensorTunes?
